descriptions.d25c_input_process_800f8dcc: When +432 is set and 0x800f899c accepts the record, push it on the vector at +316. When the vector holds more than 100 records: create the list object (retained), get one array per field, copy every record, empty the vector, send the list through virtual +40 of the sink at 0x804abac0, and release it. The 8-byte frame slot at sp+16 is the compiler assignment temporary of the polymorphic record, left by the folded erase tail copy; same record table as the 0x80344dc4 family, which writes that temporary.
